THE ARGUMENTS Three questions for the Court 1 Who can legislate? Petitioners: "betting and gambling" is a State subject (State List, Entry 34). The Union relies on its own Union List powers and Parliament's residuary power (Art. 248). 2 Is skill-gaming a protected business? Petitioners rely on Article 19(1)(g) and decades of cases treating games of substantial skill as legitimate business (Chamarbaugwala, 1957; K.R. Lakshmanan, 1996). 3 Is a total ban proportionate? Petitioners also argue the immediate shutdown was arbitrary (Article 14). The State points to addiction and losses. Adv. Ashwani Kumar 05 / 08
